title: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding
other: ICML 2023; Chen et al. 2023 in parallel
authors: Y. Leviathan, M. Kalman, Y. Matias
before: Generation produced one token per forward pass, however small the next token's uncertainty.
problem: Decoding is memory-bound and serial, so most of the GPU sits idle.
breakthrough: A small draft model proposes several tokens, the large model verifies them in one pass, and rejected tokens are corrected. Output is identical.
why: Two to three times faster generation with no quality loss, now standard in serving stacks.
next: Built into vLLM and most inference engines; the idea recurs in later decoding work.
inherits: Draft-and-verify decoding in the systems that serve your requests.
